title: Peer-reviewed study of 443,000 Backblaze hard drives ranks HGST most reliable and Toshiba the least — Analysis of 1.66 million drive-years finds Seagate and Toshiba HDDs fail at roughly twice the rate of WD and HGST
excerpt: Seagate a close second on most unreliable list
content_html:
Economists Christoph Siemroth of the University of Essex and Yeomyung Park of Sungkyunkwan University have published a peer-reviewed IEEE study that re-crunches 12 years of Backblaze's public drive data, covering 443,156 hard drives and more than 1.66 million drive-years from 2013 through Q2 2025, and finds that HGST drives fail at roughly 41% of Seagate's rate when drives of matched age, capacity, form factor, and operating temperature are compared. WD comes in at about 52% of Seagate's failure rate, while Toshiba sits in last at 107%. As for the most reliable brand in the ranking? HGST, one you can't buy new after WD acquired it in 2012 and wound it down.

Backblaze's quarterly reports compare whichever drives are available at the time, and the authors argue that approach stacks old drives against young ones because each manufacturer's fleet skews to a different era. HGST led new installations in 2014, Seagate dominated from 2015 to 2020, Toshiba topped 2023, and WD topped 2024, so raw annualized figures pit aging Seagate and HGST stock against much fresher Toshiba and WD units. A further 146,943 drives, about 31% of the sample, exited the dataset without ever failing, mostly pulled during capacity upgrades.

Toshiba's monthly failure rate more than quadruples once its drives pass 60 months in service, a monolithic jump that no other manufacturer in the dataset shows at any age. Between 50 and 100 months, Toshiba units failed at five to six per 1,000 drives per month, while the other three brands generally stayed at or below 2.5. Seagate's failure rate started highest among young drives but held steady with age. Backblaze's own analysis of its dead drives previously found most failures happened before three years of service.

Each additional one-degree Celsius of average drive temperature raised failure rates by 2.1% in the models, compounding to roughly 23% across a 10 degrees Celsius increase. Each extra terabyte of capacity cut failure rates by about 3.4%, which the authors attribute partly to helium-filled enclosures and newer head-fabrication processes in higher-capacity designs.

The dataset consists of enterprise drives run in Backblaze's data centers, so the ranking may not carry over to consumer models. Backblaze doesn't record comparable workload data across manufacturers, and only 0.52% of sampled drives ran longer than a decade, so the estimates reflect short- to medium-term reliability.

The authors also suggest WD's ownership of HGST plausibly explains why the two brands sit closest together, given the potential for shared technology. Backblaze's most recent annual report, published in February, put its fleet-wide annualized failure rate for 2025 at 1.36%.

content_html_zh:
埃塞克斯大学 (University of Essex) 的经济学家 Christoph Siemroth 和成均馆大学 (Sungkyunkwan University) 的经济学家 Yeomyung Park 发表了一项经过同行评审的 IEEE 研究，该研究重新处理了 Backblaze 12 年的公共硬盘数据，涵盖 2013 年至 2025 年第二季度的 443,156 个硬盘和超过 166 万个硬盘年数，并发现 HGST 硬盘的故障率约为 41%。比较年龄、容量、外形尺寸和工作温度相匹配的硬盘时希捷的比率。 西数的故障率约为希捷的 52%，东芝垫底，为 107%。 至于排行榜中最值得信赖的品牌？ HGST，在 WD 于 2012 年收购并逐步解散后，您就无法再购买新的了。

深入了解 TH Premium：人工智能和数据中心

Backblaze 的季度报告比较了当时可用的驱动器，作者认为这种方法将旧驱动器与新驱动器堆叠起来，因为每个制造商的机队都偏向于不同的时代。 HGST 在 2014 年引领新装机量，希捷在 2015 年至 2020 年占据主导地位，东芝在 2023 年排名第一，而 WD 在 2024 年排名第一，因此原始年化数据将老化的希捷和 HGST 库存与更新鲜的东芝和 WD 设备进行比较。 另外 146,943 个驱动器（约占样本的 31%）在没有发生故障的情况下退出了数据集，大部分是在容量升级期间拉出的。

一旦东芝的硬盘使用了 60 个月，其每月故障率就会增加四倍多，这是数据集中任何其他制造商在任何年龄都没有出现的整体跳跃。 在 50 到 100 个月之间，东芝设备的故障率为每月每 1,000 个驱动器中有 5 到 6 个故障，而其他三个品牌的故障率通常保持在或低于 2.5。 希捷的故障率在年轻硬盘中开始时最高，但随着年龄的增长保持稳定。 Backblaze 自己对其失效驱动器的分析此前发现，大多数故障发生在使用三年之前。

模型中平均驱动器温度每升高 1 摄氏度，故障率就会增加 2.1%，每升高 10 摄氏度，故障率复合增加约 23%。 每增加 TB 容量，故障率就会降低约 3.4%，作者将其部分归因于更高容量设计中的氦填充外壳和更新的磁头制造工艺。

该数据集由在 Backblaze 数据中心运行的企业驱动器组成，因此排名可能不会延续到消费者模型。 Backblaze 没有记录跨制造商的可比工作负载数据，并且只有 0.52% 的采样驱动器运行时间超过十年，因此估计反映了短期到中期的可靠性。

作者还认为，考虑到共享技术的潜力，WD 对 HGST 的所有权似乎可以解释为什么这两个品牌的关系最接近。 Backblaze 在 2 月份发布的最新年度报告显示，2025 年其整个机队的年故障率为 1.36%。
